study: Blinded random-only split-catalogue cross-Landy-Szalay and tracer-pair window audit
purpose: Check oriented LRG×ELG cross-pair estimator and tracer-specific released DR16 random selections, independently of unfinished official MANGLE/BRICKMASK byte audits. Never treat randomized pseudo-data as observed galaxies or a physical null significance test.

diagnostic_sample.split: One deterministic permutation of each independently SHA-verified random catalogue high-z selection; first 600 rows pseudo-D, next 600 rows pseudo-R, disjoint, without replacement, equal sample sizes for LRG and ELG.

fixed_checks: Full file SHA matches published observed + nine-mock pinned ensemble
Fixed sampling with no overlap within each parent random catalogue
All four independently normalized cross pair terms with normalization sum(w_first)*sum(w_second)
Independently computed reversed tracer order mirrors each oriented RR histogram and swaps cross terms
Cross-LS xi(s,mu) mirrors on its full RR-supported cells; missing RR cells remain nan
P1 and P3 of raw normalized RR flip sign under independent reversal (geometry only)
Independent scalar loop validates synthetic cross estimator before reading FITS
pilot: Observed SGC and mock 0001 SGC; full cohort observed both caps plus all nine mock IDs and both caps.
sampling_statistical_claim: No inference about physical odd signal or expected pseudo-xi significance; pseudo D and R are split from same parent catalogue, hence correlated; finite sample stochastic errors are descriptive only.
mask_policy: Use released separately constructed DR16 LRG/ELG clustering randoms without reapplying official veto polygons or forcing new common mask. Official mask membership and veto composition remain a separate pending source-based gate.
